1. This Application has been filed on behalf of the Appellant for condonation of delay of 130 days in filing the present Appeal.

3. The Application is disposed of.

1. The present Appeal under Section 419 of B.N.S.S., 2023 has been filed by the Appellant against the Judgment dated 18.12.2024 passed by the Ld. ASJ-05 (FTC)-02, South District, Saket Courts,
Delhi in Sessions Case No.6521/16 acquitting Respondent Nos.2 to 6 in FIR No.416/2012, registered at Police Station Malviya Nagar for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 304B, 406 & 34 IPC.

sentences.text:
2. Admit.
3. Let a digitized copy of the Trial Court Record (TCR) be requisitioned.
4.

On taking steps, let notice be issued to Respondent Nos.2 to 6 through all permissible modes,
including Dasti.
5. On receipt of the Trial Court Record, let the paperbook be prepared by the Registry and an e-copy of the same be supplied to the learned Counsel for the Appellant, learned APP for the State as well as the learned Counsel for Respondent Nos.2 to 6.
The Registry is directed to ensure that the paperbook and the TCR are properly bookmarked before supplying the e-copies to the Counsels.

6. List before the Ld. Joint Registrar on 13.11.2025 for further proceedings.
7.
List before Court in due course.
SUBRAMONIUM PRASAD, J VIMAL KUMAR YADAV, J OCTOBER 06, 2025 S. Zakir
